answer: Every submission must ship a short rationale hash-chained to its author; each epoch draws a blind 5% audit slice a second panel re-judges from the rationale alone. Rationales are compared token-for-token - two accounts matching on a slice are flagged as one voice and the newer forfeits credit accrued. A farm across the whole ocean of seats must keep a separate trace per head, since a pooled trace is exactly what the audit finds. If the rationale is skipped the slice cannot be graded: the seat voids, the ember of standing dies before it lights, and the grove has no proof anything was real.
